reason: I already do my big shop weekly at Spinneys or Tawfeer and fill the boot. Driving to a pickup point at their hour, 6 to 8, is no easier than driving to Jbeil myself, and I'd still be paying a fee.
objection: I'd still have to go and collect it, at their hour, not mine. No delivery means it saves me nothing, and I can't see what the person buying for me picks, or what happens if they get the wrong item.
would_change_my_mind: Home delivery, or a pickup time that suits me, plus some proof that the till prices really are lower than what I pay myself.
